description: This file defines the EditorProviders singleton class that manages registration, lookup, and lifecycle events for editor provider components within the Superset frontend. It includes event emitter logic, provider registration/unregistration, and symbol exports.

classes.name: EventEmitter
classes.description: A generic event emitter class that manages listener subscriptions and event firing for editor provider lifecycle events.

classes.name: EditorProviders
classes.description: Singleton class that manages editor provider registration, lookup, and event notifications for the Superset frontend.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes a listener to the event emitter, returning a Disposable for unsubscription.

methods.name: fire
methods.description: Fires the event, invoking all registered listeners with the provided data.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of EditorProviders.

methods.name: registerProvider
methods.description: Registers a new editor provider with associated contribution metadata and component, returning a Disposable for unregistration.

methods.name: unregisterProvider
methods.description: Unregisters an editor provider by its ID.

methods.name: getProvider
methods.description: Retrieves the provider for a specific language.

methods.name: hasProvider
methods.description: Checks if a provider exists for a given language.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the singleton (for testing).
